title: Operational and averaged check values
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game, let each vertex be assigned a bounded real-valued function on its Boolean cube, and fix a vertex and a randomized sign query check. The check’s operational value, averaging over independent uniform neighbor choices for its query positions, equals its randomized value when applied to the function obtained by averaging the neighbor-transformed table functions at that vertex.
hypotheses_covered: G is a regular unique game
A bounded long-code table is given
A sign query check is given
